messages:
Ryan: FYI rolling out a small canary for using X-Route-Priority header in the metering ingest today, starting 10:15 UTC. will route ~1% of traffic to the new path. keeping default behavior unchanged for now.
Anika: :thumbsup: what's the fallback if header is missing? we saw earlier that route_tag stripping caused unattributed tokens in invoices.
Ryan: fallback is current behavior (route resolver), but new path preserves route_resolution_id as a top-level field in the event. trying to reduce heuristic derivation.
Sam: can we add a console flag per-tenant to opt into the new path for testing? helps SEs validate without full canary.
Marta: yes please. also: telemetry concern — dashboard preview spikes when route_resolution_id flips. we need a stable key for per-route aggregation. otherwise invoices jitter.
Anika: agreed. proposal: emit both route_resolution_id and a route_fingerprint. route_fingerprint = hash(route_resolution_id || routing_policy_version). that gives deterministic grouping during rollouts.
Ryan: that makes sense. small nit: hashing at edge increases CPU on proxy; need numbers. Sam, any perf thoughts?
Sam: cheap SHA1 on header concat is fine, <1% CPU on our proxy benchmark at 1k rps per instance. we should do it in the route-resolver service instead of NGINX to avoid polyglot concerns.
Marta: UX ask: in console preview card show both "current route" and "inferred route (fingerprint)" + change history. SEs were confused when invoices changed overnight.
Anika: will that break invoice reconciliation? auditors expect stable invoice lines. If fingerprint changes with routing_policy_version we must include version in invoice metadata.
Ryan: agreed — invoice line must include routing_policy_version and route_fingerprint. we'll keep invoice grouping key = (tenant, route_fingerprint, policy_version).
IngestBot: deploy.canary: metering-route-priority v1 -> started on cluster ingest-canary-3 at 2025-03-12T10:15:20Z :rocket:
Sam: quick log we saw in dev env when header absent — duplicate events because old resolver and new path both emitted events for the same req (race):
```
2025-03-11T09:02:01Z INFO resolver: resolved route_resolution_id=R-abc123
2025-03-11T09:02:01Z INFO new-path: emitted event route_resolution_id=R-abc123
2025-03-11T09:02:01Z INFO resolver: fallback emitted event route_resolution_id=R-abc123 (again)
```
Sam: fix: de-dup by request_id at ingress aggregator before emitting to the metering topic. add a short in-memory LRU with 2s TTL.
Anika: ❤️ de-dupe helps a lot. but watch memory during bursts; add statistics and an eviction metric to console.
Marta: can we also add a canary dashboard card that overlays invoice-preview delta vs baseline for canary tenants? need +/-% and token delta.
Ryan: yes. Sam, would you own the aggregator de-dupe PR? Anika, can you file the console ticket for the preview card and eviction metrics?
Sam: yep PR incoming, will add tests for request_id dedupe and a stress run.
Anika: filing ticket now: CONS-6123 "Canary invoice preview card + dedupe metrics". adding screenshots spec.
Marta: outstanding: how do we communicate to billing ops about temporary preview deltas so they don't open tickets? suggest automation: annotate invoice-preview reports with "canary" when tenant in canary flag.
Ryan: done. we'll annotate and add a short TTL label. Ops will get a one-off email with details.
IngestBot: deploy.canary: metering-route-priority v1 -> canary rollout 1% complete on ingest-canary-3 at 2025-03-12T10:20:55Z
Sam: PR #4199 opened: metering/ingest: request_id dedupe LRU + fingerprint emission. live tests scheduled at 10:50 UTC.
Ryan: follow-ups: 1) merge PR if tests green 2) add telemetry card (Anika) 3) console UX doc update (Marta). tagging @Sam @Anika @Marta
Marta: I'll draft the UX doc and add the mock for invoice preview overlays. will ping legal for wording about "canary" labels.
Anika: thanks. if we see >0.5% invoice delta in canary tenants we pause and roll back automatically.
Ryan: agreed. stopping canary if anomaly triggers. thanks team :thumbsup:
